blind.description: A classic medieval heater shield balanced upright on its bottom point. The curved front face features a party-per-pale division with red on one half and cream/off-white on the other, surrounded by a dark riveted bronze or iron rim. The rear surface reveals a warm wood-plank finish with leather grip straps and arm loops fastened with rivets. The geometry is solid, smooth, and continuous with no floating, broken, or melted parts.
blind.from_above: A curved horizontal arc showing the outward bow of the shield, displaying the top metallic rim and thin slivers of the red and beige front face.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall and 2 feet wide, roughly mid-torso height compared to the 5 ft 9 in figure.

notes: footprint proportion 1.55x off the catalog (1.7 x 0.5 ft)
underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
